description: Read a canvas page as a tree of shapes — each with its unique name (the id ops use), type, x/y/w/h in its parent, fill, stroke, text and children, plus the page's shared styles. measure:true adds each shape's REAL box (`box`: x, y on the page, w, h) measured in a browser — use it for text, whose size the styles don't say. Read before changing a page someone else may have edited. To SEE it, use sketchxflow_canvas_screenshots. Free.

measure.description: Real sizes from a browser render (a few seconds).

name: sketchxflow_canvas_read
title: Read a canvas page's shapes
